title: Beam RPC
content:
Gravito Beam is a lightweight, type-safe RPC client that enables seamless communication between your server and frontend with zero runtime overhead. It leverages Photon's internal routing types to provide full IntelliSense.

Defining the API Type

In your server-side entry point, export the type of your routes:

const routes = app
  .get('/api/users', (c) => c.json({ name: 'Gravito' }))
  .post('/api/posts', async (c) => c.json({ ok: true }))

export type AppType = typeof routes

Grouping Routes for RPC

For complex applications, use app.route() to group logic while maintaining type safety:

// auth.ts
const auth = new Photon().post('/login', ...) 

// main.ts
const app = new Photon()
  .route('/auth', auth)
  .route('/api', api)

Using Beam Client

import { createBeam } from '@gravito/beam'
import type { AppType } from '../server'

const client = createBeam<AppType>('http://localhost:3000')

// Fully typed! 
const res = await client.api.users.$get()

Beam uses standard fetch under the hood, making it compatible with all modern environments while being 10x smaller than tRPC.
